review_state: R1-adjacent lower pair remains a pad candidate; no fitted C91 body visible at the source outline; left rail unproved
source_context: The assembly draws separate horizontal R1 and C91 outlines, stacked between D13 and D105. Sheet-1 groups C91 with +5 V-to-ground bypass capacitors C82-C93.
population_observation: In the July owner component photo 200439607, native crop (930,1550)-(1330,1680), the full gap below the fitted R1 and above D105 is exposed. The lower left round feature and lower right broad-strip joint have no discrete body or wire visibly spanning them at the C91 outline height. The wider May component photo PXL_20260519_201915520.jpg, native crop (2150,1700)-(2700,2220), independently shows the same fitted red-black-red R1 and exposed neighboring space beside D105 without a second body at the drawn C91 position; its angle does not resolve both candidate drill centers. This is two-date negative population evidence for the depicted C91 mounting, independent of whether the July features prove to be C91 pads. It cannot exclude a component fitted on the opposite face or a different board revision.
r1_band_value_crosscheck: The May full-board photo 201915520, native crop (2150,1700)-(2700,2220), resolves the fitted R1 bands from its lower lead upward as red, black, red, with a gold tolerance band at the far end. The standard four-band code is 2 kilohms, agreeing with exact .009 sheet-1 R1=2 kΩ on the D13.13/H pull-up. This independently supports the R1 body identification at the assembly position; it is not an isolated resistance measurement and does not identify C91's neighboring holes.

apparent_pair.observation: These two lower features match the horizontal C91 outline drawn directly below R1. The right metal joint is continuous on visible front copper with R1's right landing. The source PCB places R1.1 on the right at (40.88,210.0) mm and assigns it P5V; R1.2 is the left H landing. A native crop of owner photo 200439607 at (1160,1490)-(1390,1750) shows the right joint feeding a broad vertical strip beside D105, but D105's top-right pin1 contact is left of that strip with visible board clearance. The earlier claimed right-joint→D105.1/IO_CYCLE_H connection is not photo-proved and contradicted the modeled R1 +5 V landing. The right joint is therefore a plausible +5 V C91 site, subject to owner continuity; the left lower annulus still needs a ground check.
apparent_pair.decision: Withdraw the earlier D105.1-based exclusion. Retain the lower left annulus and right R1.1-connected joint as a leading C91 search pair, but do not assign a footprint until the left hole is proved ground and the right joint is confirmed +5 V on the owner board.

correction_evidence: The source PCB and docs/d105-h-boundary.md place R1.1 at the photographed right end on P5V and R1.2 at the left end on D105_10_H. KiCad D105.1 is separately IO_CYCLE_H, with its top-right contact visibly left of the broad vertical copper strip from the lower right joint. Native owner crop (1160,1490)-(1390,1750) resolves the front-copper R1-right→lower-right-joint loop and the gap to D105.1. The former C91 exclusion depended on a false D105.1 join; it is retired. Exact .009 assembly 114604420 draws C91 below R1 at this geometry.
solder_side_search: Composing the existing component-tile, board, and solder-tile registrations projects front lower features (1025,1620)/(1270,1620) into solder photo PXL_20260710_200537608.jpg near (2499,1259)/(2231,1259). A native crop (1900,850)-(2800,1600) contains multiple package joint columns, open annuli, and traces; neither projected point is a uniquely resolved matching drill center. The component panorama fit has 27.321 px held-out error, amplified in the native tile, so these old coordinates are retired as pad searches. The D105-local fit and candidate ground corridor below supersede them; exact through-hole identities and owner continuity remain open.
d105_local_two_face_fit: Front photo 200439607's seven D105 upper contact centers are read at approximately x=[874,930,991,1052,1113,1175,1228], y≈1680; solder photo 200537608's mirrored upper centers at x=[3057,2995,2933,2872,2810,2748,2687], y≈1190. Their least-squares horizontal reflection is x_s≈3956.52−1.03133*x_f with ≈2.2 px RMS contact-center residual. The lower package rows near front y≈1844 and solder y≈1375 give an approximate vertical scale 1.13; extrapolating the upper row to front C91 y≈1620 gives solder y≈1122. Thus the front C91 pair (1025,1620)/(1270,1620) searches near (2899,1122)/(2647,1122), within about 10 px of the U-strip endpoint (≈2890,1122) and the separate left solder feature (≈2640,1120). This is a strong local geometric match, but the ≈2 px row residual does not bound error at extrapolated C91 holes; neither feature has an independently identified same-hole landmark. The previous broad panorama projections (2499,1259)/(2231,1259) are retired.
left_ground_corridor_candidate: At solder search x≈2890–2910,y≈1120–1130, a tinned U-shaped copper strip has a soldered left endpoint and runs right, then down into the rightmost contact of D105's upper seven-contact row near x≈3058,y≈1186. D105 has a right-facing notch on the component side, so that reflected rightmost upper contact is physical pin7, GND in the source PCB and device power table. The front left C91 annulus near (1025,1620) maps close to the tinned strip's left endpoint under the D105-local fit. This is a plausible ground-side C91 landing, not a proved same drill or measured owner continuity. The front right C91 joint maps near a separate soldered feature around (2640,1120) and visibly shares R1's source-assigned +5 V front landing.
next_inspection: With power off, meter the lower right joint near (1270,1620) to R1 right/+5 V and separately to D105.1/IO_CYCLE_H; confirm they are distinct. Meter the lower left annulus near (1025,1620) to D105.7/GND and inspect whether its exact solder counterpart is the U-shaped strip endpoint near (2900,1125) in 200537608. Confirm both holes and owner rails before promoting C91.
